item.title: Customer Support Specialist
item.dc:creator: Example Support Co.
item.description:
Example Support Co. is seeking a customer support specialist to help customers solve product questions and account problems.

You will investigate reports, explain solutions, record useful details, and collaborate with product and engineering teammates.

Strong written communication, patience, good judgment, and careful follow-through are important for this remote position.

Experience with support tools and distributed teams is welcome. You will help maintain a reliable, respectful customer experience.

item.title: Sales Development Representative
item.description:
This full time sales role will identify prospective customers, conduct thoughtful outreach, and qualify opportunities for the team.

Successful candidates communicate clearly, maintain accurate pipeline records, and coordinate discovery meetings with account executives across a distributed organization.

Previous experience with customer conversations, CRM software, and business development is useful. The team values curiosity, accountability, and consistent follow up with potential customers.
